name: Aeqium
summary: Aeqium is compensation planning software. Its homepage lists salary bands with compa-ratios and equity gaps, merit matrices and bonus formulas inside cycle workflows, and pay equity monitoring. Its plans page names modules and add-ons but publishes no prices, so buyers request a demo to get pricing.

facts.text: The homepage lists 'Salary bands, compa-ratios, equity gaps' and has a section headed 'Compensation Benchmarks, Salary Bands, and Analytics'.
The homepage says: 'Build merit matrices, bonus formulas, approval chains, and proration logic exactly the way your organization works.'
The homepage says: 'Monitor pay equity, spot retention risks, and understand compensation patterns before they become problems.'

The plans page lists a Compensation Management plan, labeled Foundations, with cycle management, compensation bands and interactive offer letters. Pay Equity is listed as one of the Compensation Analysis add-ons.
The plans page says: 'We'll configure your complete compensation process in Aeqium at no charge when you request a demo.' The page does not publish a free plan.

plans.name: Compensation Management (Foundations)
plans.notes: The plans page lists cycle management, compensation bands and interactive offer letters with no price. Buyers request a demo to get pricing.

plans.name: Compensation Analysis add-ons
plans.notes: Automated compensation alerts, the My Team manager reporting suite and Pay Equity are listed as add-ons with no price.

hiddenCosts: The plans page shows no prices, currency or billing period, so the cost of each module and add-on is not known from the vendor site.
